title: odontites ruber subsp. serotinus

It is a parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by attaching to the roots of other plants, such as grasses and sedges. The health benefits of Odontites ruber subsp. serotinus include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory agent, and it is also reported to have antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
